create_tables.name: gov_finance_items
create_tables.purpose: Single flat Finance item master with optional soft link to the existing UNSPSC catalog

columns.gov_code: CHAR(6) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL

population.source: FinanceDivData/tagging-design/finance_items.csv: entry_key becomes gov_code; source components retained by deterministic slicing
population.activated_by: existing national catalog publisher with exact reviewed Finance payload and authority evidence

invariants: six digit string GGSSII; validate all components and hierarchy labels
unspsc_code is a soft link (no FK, matching catalog convention that survives truncates/re-imports); NULL or an existing level-4 commodity validated on save and on read
held/active/retired status only
no reverse gov_code column on UNSPSC
never delete or reuse assigned Finance codes
new meaning requires new code; description corrections audited
source conflicts stay held until resolved
approved labels consistent across shared group/subgroup keys
prohibit direct national writes outside existing catalog control

create_tables.name: gov_metadata_values
create_tables.purpose: Typed GovStore metadata: company code lists, office tag settings, office enablement and product-type Finance defaults; one row per subject+namespace; owner scope recorded

columns.subject_type: VARCHAR(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL
columns.namespace: VARCHAR(50) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL
columns.scope_type: VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL

population.entered_by: company code lists: company admin; office selections: own office_admin; enablement: deployment operator; global product-type default: national catalog publisher; company product-type default: owning company's scoped product-type editor
population.company_subject: subject_type=company, subject_id=company ID, scope=company, namespace=asset-tagging.codelists; {locations:[{code,name}], divisions:[{code,name}]} by company admin
population.office_subject: subject_type=office, subject_id=office location ID, scope=office, namespace=asset-tagging.office; {location_code, division_codes[], default_division_code} selected from the company lists; namespace=asset-tagging.enablement (scope national) written only by the operator after gates
population.product_subject: subject_type=category, subject_id=product-type category ID, scope derived from gov_category_governance (global or missing -> national/0; company -> company/created_by_company_id), namespace=asset-tagging.default; payload.gov_code optional
population.activated_by: no additional workflow; typed scoped validation plus deployment enablement
population.initial: no invented native IDs or defaults

invariants: allowlist office/category subject types and typed namespace schemas
uniqueness on subject, not scope: exactly one Finance default per product type and one fact set per office; no NULLs in unique keys
scope is re-derived from category governance on every read; a mismatch marks the value needs_review and GRN ignores it
offices never override a product-type default
subject_id is a soft reference; validate existence and visibility on save and use; stale subjects never produce a default
max payload 16 KiB; at most 99 entries per company list
two-digit text codes unique within each company list; an entry in use can be renamed, never removed or re-coded
office values must exist in the current company lists; a location code belongs to at most one office per company; default division is one of the office divisions; no authority reference
optional gov_code is NULL or an active Finance item whose unspsc_code is NULL or equals the product type's single UNSPSC code
revision check plus audit before/after
no formatter code, national codes, counters or deployment enablement in editable metadata
existing metadata compiler/mapping/convergence records remain unchanged

create_tables.name: gov_asset_tag_sequences
create_tables.purpose: Atomic bounded FD18 prefix and new-Finance-code allocation

columns.namespace: VARCHAR(50) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL
columns.scope_key: VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL

population.source: service reads retained tags / existing and retired Finance codes at controlled initialization
population.activated_by: no human editor; initialized after collision preflight

invariants: race-safe first insert, then SELECT FOR UPDATE in sorted (namespace, scope_key) order for the whole posting before any asset is created
fixed server namespaces, never client-provided
asset-tag:fd18 scope is exact first14 characters, global within installation

finance-code:item scope GG (II is a running number across the whole group in all 490 source rows); after an approved D-08 Option A a full group switches to scope GGSS by reviewed config; finance-code:subgroup scope GG; finance-code:group scope root
capacity warning from 90 used item numbers in a group; refuse at 99 until D-08 is decided
do not partition physical counter by office, company or formatter version
bounds 9999 for physical suffix, 99 for Finance component; no wrap/reset/reuse
standard tags use the native settings sequence, not this table
single authoritative DB; clones disabled; restore fencing required

alter_tables.name: gov_asset_registrations
alter_tables.purpose: Retain receipt-unit identity and tag-generation evidence using the existing bridge

add_columns.gov_code: CHAR(6) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL

column_rationale.unit_index: Equals GRN row_index; quantity 3 means units 0,1,2; unique item/ordinal makes retries safe
column_rationale.format_version: fd18-v1 (Finance tag), native-v1 (standard tag), entered-v1 (typed in an office that is not enabled); immutable
column_rationale.gov_code: Finance classification frozen at issue; NULL is valid for standard and entered tags because the Finance Code is optional
column_rationale.tag_snapshot: Encoded segments, acquisition date and evidence reference, office/company facts and metadata revisions, Finance source (product_type/line_choice/none), standard-tag reason, actor

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (gov_code) REFERENCES gov_finance_items(gov_code) ON DELETE RESTRICT
alter_tables.foreign_key_change: Keep intake_item_id NOT NULL; replace its existing gov_document_items ON DELETE CASCADE with RESTRICT using inspected actual constraint name

population.existing_rows: nullable new columns; preserve historical evidence; reconcile duplicates before indexes
population.entered_by: GovStore GRN posting service in same transaction as ordinary native asset creation
population.new_rows: unit_index, format_version and tag_snapshot required for every new registration (enabled or not); gov_code required only for fd18-v1

deferred_not_in_initial_migration.source_kind_and_source_key: Only needed for non-GRN issuance; initial origin already identified by intake_item_id
deferred_not_in_initial_migration.nullable_intake_item_id: Unnecessary while issuance is GRN-based; retain mandatory receipt provenance
deferred_not_in_initial_migration.tag_key: Would duplicate asset_tag; reconsider only if actual historical duplicate rows prevent safe all-time uniqueness
deferred_not_in_initial_migration.office_location_id_and_company_id: Current scope comes from receipt/document relations; original facts are in snapshot

invariants: append-only after committed registration; retain tag after native asset deletion/disposal
ExperimentWiper refuses to delete fd18-v1/native-v1 rows
existing asset_tag is the reserved issued string; no new duplicate tag field
document state lock is first retry defense, source-unit unique index second
legacy duplicate/source ambiguity stops affected rollout; never silently drop or merge evidence
document deletion cannot erase issuance history; draft cleanup unaffected
do not add native model relations, casts, fields or migrations

alter_tables.name: gov_catalog_snipe_mappings
alter_tables.purpose: Enforce exactly one UNSPSC code per product type
drop_constraints: existing non-unique category_id index (inspect actual name)

invariants: assigning a different code to a mapped category replaces the row (change of commodity), never adds one
change of commodity marks a conflicting Finance default needs_review; never remaps automatically
existing UNIQUE(code) unchanged

reuse_without_schema_change.gov_document_item_meta: saved per-unit input using existing row_index; no schema change
reuse_without_schema_change.gov_documents / gov_document_items / pos: same document transaction; one pre-posting hook after the document lock

reuse_without_schema_change.gov_catalog_nodes / enrichments / synony: UNSPSC unchanged, no reverse Finance column

reuse_without_schema_change.gov_metadata_field_mappings / gov_model_: existing field compiler and model convergence unchanged

reuse_without_schema_change.existing audit / catalog review / native: reuse evidence and printing; explicitly extend supported Finance catalog payload

read local live testing guide before database verification
